# Spaces

> Spaces is an open-source agent workspace manager: a self-hosted server that
> runs AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and more) in terminal
> panes grouped into workspaces, tracks each agent's state (working, blocked,
> idle, done), notifies you when one needs attention, and serves web, terminal
> (TUI), and VR clients from the same runtime.

Spaces is Apache-2.0 licensed, installs via `npm install -g @jlongo78/agent-spaces`, and
runs with the `spaces` command. Agents inside panes get a message bus
(`spaces-msg` CLI and the `spaces-bus` MCP server) for agent-to-agent and
agent-to-human communication.

## Docs

- [Agent guide](/agent-guide.md): how a coding agent inside a Spaces pane
  identifies its environment and uses the message bus
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jlongo78/spaces/main/docs/getting-started.md): install and first run
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jlongo78/spaces/main/docs/architecture.md): server, runtime, clients, and how they fit
